reviews.review: It's a very awesome game. So why the thumbs down? because there are a few annoying glitches, which I can look past, but there is a game breaking glitch in the campaign in which you cannot board a speedboat to complete the mission and I've seen many others on the net with the same problem. I'm sure there's a fix for this somewhere but since I payed $60 and since this has been out for more than a year in which this should have been patched. I'll give the game a thumbs up when the developers of this game get they're ♥♥♥♥ together and provide customer support. Until then it's a thumbs down and will not be buying anymore games Bohemia Interactive if this is what I going to expect.

Towed a quadbike to my truck. I entered my truck and within about 3 seconds, I was in the stratosphere.

10/10

Bohemia would rather invest in textures and door-sounds than fix their game. Average of 20fps in MP, and the desync is getting progressively worse. I see more features being released, and more things get broken. It has gone from Beta to Alpha IMO.

1/10

Unrealisitic and godlike AI that will discourage you from playing campaign mode.  AI is extremely accurate and their senses seem to be almost alien like with an awareness that is just outrageous.  The armor seems to have some sort of alien human detection system that detect humans from any distance no matter where you hide and they never miss.  The weapon bounce especially after running short distances is also very unrealistic and almost too exagerated to the point that hitting anyone over 200 meters becomes a chore while the AI will seem to zero in on you with no problems.  Exhaustion and weapon bounce is the biggest problems with this game because the developers have over exagerhated the effects.  Good luck and consider this. 
Aside from all this, I will still recomend the game.  It has alot of potential
